verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a webhook subscription API that sends events for chosen subscription_types on state changes. Before delivery starts, the subscription must be verified with a verification_token, and payloads are HMAC-signed so receivers can confirm authenticity. Gusto also provides a webhooks health-check endpoint and concrete events such as payroll.paid. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, and a full event-type catalog and retry/delivery semantics in the evidence.
